(4) One row (id 0) had a body mass of 3,625,000 g (likely a typo with extra zeros), which was excluded as it was far outside the valid range (2500-6500 g). The 3 missing 'sex' values were left as-is (per rules: do not guess). After cleaning, the average body mass is 3876.0 g for females and 4485.2 g for males.
